items.source_reference: G; [Meta developers](https://developers.facebook.com/). Group bị hạn chế không mặc định truy cập.
items.revalidation_note: Meta Content Library exposes selected public content through a researcher product; ordinary Graph API access is permission and app-review controlled. This does not establish a general public trend feed or TrendScout access.

items.source_reference: G; [Instagram platform](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/); scopes/use case cần duyệt.
items.revalidation_note: The Instagram Media endpoint returns media owned by Instagram professional accounts. Meta Content Library provides a defined public-content subset for approved researchers; this is not general public discovery. TrendScout access is unverified.

items.source_reference: R; [Data API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/search/list); D3B synthetic.
items.revalidation_note: Search.list returns query results, not audience size. Its default project limit is 100 calls per day; this account's actual quota and TrendScout approval remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Research Tools](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/research-api/) yêu cầu điều kiện phi thương mại; [Commercial Content API](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/commercial-content-api) nêu phạm vi EU, chưa xác nhận phù hợp US.
items.revalidation_note: Research Tools require an eligible, approved public-interest research project and non-commercial research. They do not establish access for a commercial TrendScout product; no TrendScout approval or credentials are verified.

items.source_reference: G; [Search Posts](https://docs.x.com/x-api/posts/search/introduction).
items.revalidation_note: Recent Search covers the last seven days; full-archive Search is limited to pay-per-use and Enterprise customers. Results are query-scoped, and TrendScout access, usage cost, and population-representative US coverage are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Threads keyword search](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/keyword-search); permission approval và quota cần review.
items.revalidation_note: Keyword Search can return public Threads posts with an approved threads_keyword_search permission; before approval it searches only the authenticated user's posts. The documented per-user limit is 2,200 queries per rolling 24 hours, and results do not represent all US discussion.

items.source_reference: G; [Data API terms](https://redditinc.com/policies/data-api-terms): thương mại cần thỏa thuận riêng; nội dung/retention có hạn chế.
items.revalidation_note: Reddit requires a separate agreement for commercial Data API use or use beyond the expressly permitted terms. API credentials, rate limits, content retention/removal rules, and TrendScout approval remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Public Profile API](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/Public-Profile-API/GetStarted); allowlist bắt buộc.
items.revalidation_note: The Public Profile API requires allowlisting and OAuth. Its public endpoints expose a subset of profile metadata and asset statistics; Creator Discovery searches eligible creators, not general public keyword trends. TrendScout access is unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [terms](https://developers.pinterest.com/terms/) hạn chế lưu và platform insights nếu thiếu quyền; [rate limits](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/reference/rate-limits/) theo tier.
items.revalidation_note: Pinterest documents a trends_read rate-limit category for trending keyword information. API use requires an approved app; Trial and Standard tiers have different limits. This does not establish TrendScout access or measure overall US demand.

items.source_reference: G; [Community Management API access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/community-management-overview); app review required.
items.revalidation_note: Community Management API access requires LinkedIn review and has Development and Standard tiers; API requests are authenticated. This is not a general public keyword-search feed, and TrendScout approval or coverage is unverified.

revalidation_links.label: Official Community Management API access overview

items.source_reference: G; [WhatsApp Business Platform](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview/); business messaging API.
items.revalidation_note: The documented Business Platform APIs send and receive messages for a business phone number and manage business messaging; they do not expose a public conversation or keyword-trend search feed. Business API access is not evidence of permission to inspect private conversations, and TrendScout access is unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [API catalog](https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/introduction) documents neighborhood trend and keyword search; API access is gated.
items.revalidation_note: Official documentation describes trending neighborhood posts and keyword/location search, but says access is closed beta and requires an application, OAuth credentials, and provider approval. A local conversation sample is not nationally representative; TrendScout access, terms, quotas, and geographic coverage are unverified.

revalidation_links.label: Official API products and access requirements

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://docs.bsky.app/docs/api/app-bsky-feed-get-feed) mô tả public reads; commercial, quota, retention và US scope cần review.
items.revalidation_note: Most app.bsky GET endpoints are public through Bluesky AppView, but feeds and results remain within Bluesky and the selected feed/search. This is not a population-level US demand measure; TrendScout access and collection scope are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [TMTG SEC filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1849635/000143774926026777/djt20260630_10q.htm) documents the paid Truth API feed.
items.revalidation_note: TMTG reported launching Truth API in August 2026 as a business-to-business subscription feed for public posts from certain top accounts. This is a scoped commercial feed, not an unrestricted public API; exact access terms, price, coverage, and TrendScout eligibility remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [BeReal Terms of Service](https://bereal.com/terms); no official public developer discovery API verified.
items.revalidation_note: The official materials reviewed do not verify an approved public developer API for platform-wide post discovery; BeReal?s Terms of Service describe a service for human users and content rights, not a TrendScout search feed. Treat API availability, public-post coverage, terms, and TrendScout eligibility as unknown; do not rely on unofficial app endpoints.

items.source_reference: G; [Discord Developer Policy](https://support-dev.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/8563934450327-Discord-Developer-Policy) limits API data use and forbids scraping.
items.revalidation_note: Discord API access is scoped to an application?s authorized servers and permissions; it is not a platform-wide public conversation search feed. The Developer Policy prohibits scraping service data and restricts API data to the approved application purpose, so do not collect Discord content as a broad trend dataset without explicit policy-compatible authorization.

revalidation_links.label: Official Discord API data access changes

items.source_reference: G; [Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api), [privacy mode](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features), and [content licensing terms](https://telegram.org/tos/content-licensing).
items.revalidation_note: Bot API updates cover chats/channels where a bot is present and authorized, with group visibility constrained by privacy mode; they do not provide a general platform-wide post-search feed. Telegram?s terms restrict access to ordinary legitimate platform use and prohibit scraping/indexing/aggregation to create large datasets. TrendScout access and compliant scope are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://docs.joinmastodon.org/api/); quyền, scope và coverage theo instance.
items.revalidation_note: Public timeline access is per Mastodon instance; an instance may disable unauthenticated access. Instance-specific limits and federation mean one server is not a complete Mastodon sample. No instance coverage or TrendScout access is verified.

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://www.tumblr.com/docs/en/api/v2); quyền, quota và commercial review còn mở.
items.revalidation_note: Tumblr's official API resource lists default limits of 1,000 calls per hour and 5,000 per day per consumer key, with a request process for higher limits. API access and TrendScout approval remain unverified; these limits do not establish representative US trend coverage.

revalidation_links.label: Tumblr developer resources and default API limits

items.source_reference: U; [Quora](https://www.quora.com/); không giả định API discovery phù hợp.
items.revalidation_note: The official materials reviewed do not establish a generally available public keyword-search API for TrendScout. Search-engine visibility is not permission for automated collection; API access, licensing, and coverage remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://api.stackexchange.com/); review license và attribution từng nội dung.
items.revalidation_note: The API returns activity from a selected Stack Exchange site and applies daily/application throttles; its default quota is 10,000 requests per day per key. This measures network-specific Q&A activity, not general US demand; TrendScout key and attribution compliance are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Slack API](https://api.slack.com/); workspace consent không tạo quyền quét toàn nền tảng.
items.revalidation_note: Slack Real-time Search is limited to internal or directory-published apps and user/workspace scopes. Slack explicitly prohibits storing or copying its returned data, so this API cannot support TrendScout's persistent cross-workspace trend ledger. No app approval or workspace access is verified.

revalidation_links.label: Slack Real-time Search access and data rules
Slack search method scope and rate limit

items.source_reference: U; [Lemmy](https://join-lemmy.org/); access và policy theo instance.
items.revalidation_note: Lemmy's API connects to a selected instance. What it can return depends on that instance's federation and access state, so one server is not a verified complete view of the network or US activity. Many actions are rate-limited by client IP; TrendScout access and coverage are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://docs.discourse.org/); consent và terms theo instance.
items.revalidation_note: Discourse exposes some unauthenticated endpoints, while most API access requires a key created by that forum's administrator and follows the selected user's permissions. This is site-specific forum access, not a cross-site public discovery feed. No target forums, keys, or permission are verified.

revalidation_links.label: Official Discourse API documentation and authentication
Create and configure a Discourse API key

items.source_reference: U; [Fandom](https://www.fandom.com/); content rights and scope vary by community.
items.revalidation_note: Fandom's official terms distinguish user submissions from company-owned original content. The reviewed official materials did not establish a Fandom-wide public trend API or one license for content across all communities; content rights, API access, and coverage must be verified per use.

revalidation_links.label: Fandom Terms of Use and content ownership

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/); OAuth and endpoint-specific permissions apply.
items.revalidation_note: Twitch's API supports channel and category searches using an OAuth app or user token; app requests use a rate-limited token bucket. Search results describe Twitch channels/categories, not overall US demand, and TrendScout app registration/access remains unverified.

revalidation_links.label: Twitch authentication and API rate limits

items.source_reference: G; [Public API](https://docs.kick.com/); OAuth 2.1; broad trend measurement not verified.
items.revalidation_note: Kick now documents a public API with OAuth 2.1 and endpoints including categories and channels. The documented endpoint set does not establish a broad historical keyword-trend measure; TrendScout use, quota, and commercial approval remain unverified.

items.source_reference: U; [Advertising API](https://ads.rumble.com/docs/api/); public-content API not verified.
items.revalidation_note: The official Rumble Advertising Center API covers an account's advertising data and requires a bearer API key; its documentation does not establish a public-video discovery or general keyword-trend API. No suitable public content API or TrendScout permission is verified.

revalidation_links.label: Rumble Advertising Center API scope and access

items.source_reference: G; [API](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/guides/start); registered app/token; quota varies by account.
items.revalidation_note: Vimeo documents video search, but API access requires a registered app and access token; public-data access still uses an authenticated token. Per-user rate limits vary by Vimeo membership (25 to 2,500 requests per minute in the current table). Search results are Vimeo-specific, not population-representative US demand; TrendScout access is unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [API v2](https://developers.dailymotion.com/docs/welcome); mọi yêu cầu cần token; quyền TrendScout chưa xác minh.
items.revalidation_note: Dailymotion API v2 is the current documented API and provides video resources, but its calls require an authenticated access token. API access, usable discovery scope, quota, and permission for TrendScout remain unverified; platform video activity is not general US demand.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Lemon8](https://www.lemon8-app.com/legal/terms-of-service); tự động thu thập cần được cho phép.
items.revalidation_note: The official Lemon8 terms reviewed prohibit automated scripts that collect information from or interact with the service unless expressly permitted. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public keyword-discovery API or written permission for TrendScout; do not collect through scraping or unofficial endpoints.

items.source_reference: G; [API v2](https://docs.patreon.com/); OAuth theo tài khoản/chiến dịch, không phải nguồn xu hướng công khai.
items.revalidation_note: Patreon API v2 exposes creator, campaign, member, and post resources through OAuth scopes tied to the authorizing account. Public API v1 stopped responding on October 7, 2026 (approved extensions run through January 20, 2027); the reviewed API does not establish platform-wide keyword discovery or TrendScout access.

revalidation_links.label: v1 to v2 migration and retirement

items.source_reference: G; [Open API](https://developers.etsy.com/documentation/); ứng dụng cần duyệt; phân tích dữ liệu cần Etsy cho phép bằng văn bản.
items.revalidation_note: Etsy Open API access requires a registered app and review for use beyond a seller's own shop. Etsy's API Terms expressly prohibit using Etsy data for analytics or machine learning without written authorization, so TrendScout must not analyze marketplace listings absent that permission; scraping is also prohibited.

revalidation_links.label: Etsy Open API access and review

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Poshmark](https://poshmark.com/terms); cấm tự động thu thập nếu chưa được cho phép.
items.revalidation_note: Poshmark's current terms prohibit scraping and automated systems that collect service information, and restrict third-party content to explicitly authorized purposes. The reviewed official materials do not establish an authorized public listing-discovery API or TrendScout permission; do not use unofficial endpoints.

items.source_reference: G; [Depop Selling API](https://partnerapi.depop.com/api-docs/terms/); quyền phân tích cần được cho phép.
items.revalidation_note: Depop's Selling API is an enterprise-partner API with product and shop scopes, not evidence of a public marketplace-wide trend feed. Its terms prohibit using Depop data for analytics or machine learning without written authorization and prohibit scraping; TrendScout has no verified partner access.

items.source_reference: G; [Seller API](https://developers.whatnot.com/getting-started/introduction) phục vụ cửa hàng đã ủy quyền, không phải tìm kiếm thị trường.
items.revalidation_note: Whatnot's Seller API manages an authorized seller's store, products, inventory, orders, shows, and analytics. Its Terms of Service prohibit automated use and scraping; no public marketplace-wide discovery API or TrendScout permission was established.

items.source_reference: U; [Quy tắc Mercari US](https://www.mercari.com/us/help_center/topics/listing/policies/prohibited-conduct/); cấm tự động trích xuất.
items.revalidation_note: Mercari's US prohibited-conduct policy bars robots, spiders, crawlers, scrapers, and other automated interfaces not provided by Mercari from accessing the service or extracting data. The reviewed official materials do not establish an authorized public listing API or TrendScout permission; do not use unofficial endpoints.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản OfferUp](https://offerup.com/terms); tự động truy cập phải do OfferUp cung cấp.
items.revalidation_note: OfferUp's Terms of Service prohibit automated means to use the service or collect/extract its data unless the means are provided by OfferUp. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public discovery API or written permission for TrendScout; do not scrape listings or use unofficial endpoints.

items.source_reference: G; [TikTok Shop Partner API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/); dữ liệu giới hạn theo shop/creator được ủy quyền.
items.revalidation_note: TikTok Shop APIs require a partner app and seller or creator authorization; product and performance results are scoped to the linked shop or creator. Keyword product search in affiliate APIs is limited to products linked to an authorized creator/shop, not a public marketplace-wide trend feed. TrendScout access and scopes remain unverified.

revalidation_links.label: TikTok Shop Partner Center API documentation
Get Shop Products for an authorized creator

items.source_reference: U; [Facebook Marketplace](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/); tự động thu thập cần Meta cho phép bằng văn bản.
items.revalidation_note: The reviewed official materials do not establish a public Facebook Marketplace listing-search API for TrendScout. Meta's Automated Data Collection Terms require express written permission before automated collection from Meta products; public visibility alone is not authorization.

items.source_reference: G; [Amazon Creators API](https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/creatorsapi/docs/); cần Associates eligibility, tối đa 10 kết quả mỗi truy vấn.
items.revalidation_note: Amazon's Creators API supports keyword product search for enrolled Amazon Associates; access requires marketplace enrollment, at least 10 qualifying sales in the prior 30 days, registration, and credentials. Search returns at most 10 items per request and does not measure demand or sales trends; TrendScout eligibility and permitted use remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Walmart Marketplace API](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/authentication-authorization); OAuth giới hạn theo seller ủy quyền.
items.revalidation_note: Walmart Marketplace APIs use OAuth permissions granted by a seller and expose that seller's catalog, items, and performance insights. They do not provide verified public marketplace-wide product discovery for TrendScout; seller authorization, API approval, and permitted analytics use remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [eBay Browse API](https://developer.ebay.com/develop/api/buy/browse_api/item/search); production use requires partner approval and permitted use.
items.revalidation_note: eBay Browse API supports keyword searches and returns matching marketplace items. Production Buy API use is limited to approved eBay partners and intended buying experiences; eBay says other uses of its data are typically not permitted. TrendScout production approval and a permitted trend-analysis use are unverified.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản SHEIN US](https://app.shein.com/9/36ccile61bw3); thu thập tự động cần SHEIN cho phép trước bằng văn bản.
items.revalidation_note: SHEIN's US Terms of Use restrict access to personal, non-commercial shopping and prohibit robots or automated processes from accessing or indexing the service. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public product-discovery API or prior written consent for TrendScout; do not scrape or analyze listings without authorization.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Temu US](https://www.temu.com/us-pt/terms-of-use.html); cấm quét dữ liệu và giới hạn sử dụng cá nhân.
items.revalidation_note: The Temu US terms page updated November 1, 2026 restricts service use to personal, non-commercial purposes and prohibits crawling, scraping, or using automated software to access service data. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public product-discovery API or written authorization for TrendScout.

items.source_reference: G; [Shopify API Terms](https://www.shopify.com/legal/api-terms); cấm tạo chỉ mục sản phẩm hoặc thu thập hệ thống.
items.revalidation_note: Shopify APIs access merchant data only within permissions granted by each merchant and Shopify. Current API Terms prohibit systematic data collection and building commerce/product indexes, so they cannot be used to aggregate independent stores into TrendScout's product-trend index without explicit Shopify authorization.

items.source_reference: U; [Wayfair](https://www.wayfair.com/); tài liệu đã xem chưa xác nhận API tìm kiếm công khai.
items.revalidation_note: The reviewed official Wayfair materials did not establish a public product-search API, a partner discovery feed, or authorization for TrendScout to collect catalog and demand data. Treat product discovery access and commercial data rights as unverified; do not infer permission from the customer-facing search site.

items.source_reference: G; [Houzz Pro API](https://developer.houzz.com/docs/api-overview) dành tích hợp Pro; điều khoản cấm khai thác dữ liệu.
items.revalidation_note: Houzz Pro provides an OAuth-authenticated API for Pro business integrations, while Houzz's Terms of Use prohibit data mining, scraping, and commercial use of product descriptions or professional listings for another merchant's benefit without permission. No public consumer product-trend API or TrendScout authorization was established.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/c/Terms_of_Use); chỉ cho phép xem cá nhân, phi thương mại; hạn chế trích xuất.
items.revalidation_note: The Home Depot Terms of Use grant personal, non-commercial site viewing and restrict copying, distribution, or gathering site information for reseller activity. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public catalog-search API or permission for TrendScout; do not use storefront endpoints or scraping as substitutes.

revalidation_links.label: The Home Depot Terms of Use

items.source_reference: G; [Lowe's Developer Hub](https://developer.lowes.com/); API catalog dành đối tác bán sản phẩm, cần quyền truy cập.
items.revalidation_note: Lowe's Developer Hub documents partner APIs and catalog feeds that let a storefront list and sell Lowe's products, with search, pricing, inventory, and promotions. This is a partner shopping integration rather than a public demand-measurement feed; TrendScout's partner access and rights to retain/analyze the catalog remain unverified.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Target](https://www.target.com/c/terms-conditions/-/N-4sr7l); cấm thu thập thương mại và lập chỉ mục sản phẩm.
items.revalidation_note: Target's current Terms prohibit commercial use or collection of product listings and prices, systematic downloading into a database, and unauthorized automated querying or scraping. Approved shopping agents are limited to Target-authorized use and do not authorize TrendScout's research collection; no public catalog API for TrendScout was established.

items.source_reference: U; [Điều khoản Nordstrom](https://www.nordstrom.com/browse/customer-service/policy/terms-conditions); cấm scraper và sử dụng thương mại.
items.revalidation_note: Nordstrom's Terms grant only personal, non-commercial use and expressly prohibit robots, spiders, scrapers, and other automated access to or crawling of the site. No authorized public product-discovery API or TrendScout permission was established; do not collect storefront listings.

items.source_reference: G; [Merchant API](https://developers.google.com/merchant/api); quyền truy cập dữ liệu merchant được ủy quyền, không phải dữ liệu tìm kiếm Shopping.
items.revalidation_note: Google Merchant API manages an individual merchant's products, inventory, and related Merchant Center resources; access depends on that merchant's authorization. It is not an API for searching Google Shopping across merchants or measuring consumer demand. TrendScout access and an eligible use remain unverified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [official API](https://github.com/HackerNews/API); content license và US scope cần review.
items.revalidation_note: The official Firebase API provides public Hacker News story and item data, with no rate limit stated in its current guide. Top/new story rankings are specific to Hacker News and do not measure overall US demand; TrendScout use is unverified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [Product Hunt API](https://api.producthunt.com/v2/docs); API công khai cần token, mặc định không dùng thương mại.
items.revalidation_note: Product Hunt exposes public launch data through an authenticated GraphQL API. Its official documentation says commercial use is not permitted by default and requires contacting Product Hunt; documented limits are 6,250 GraphQL complexity points per 15 minutes per app. Launch activity measures Product Hunt's technology community, not overall market demand; TrendScout has no verified commercial permission.

revalidation_links.label: Product Hunt API documentation and commercial use

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [Substack Developer API Terms](https://substack.com/api-tos); API cho phép discovery/analytics dữ liệu hồ sơ công khai, có giới hạn dùng.
items.revalidation_note: Substack's Developer API Terms permit discovery and analytics using specified information creators make public on their profiles or publications, such as subscriber totals and category rankings. Do not infer non-public attributes, redistribute the data as a dataset, or imply completeness; attribution, refresh/removal of changed data, discretionary rate limits, and TrendScout API access must be verified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: F; [Medium API](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/213480228-API-Importing) không cấp token tích hợp mới; RSS vẫn có cho hồ sơ/chủ đề.
items.revalidation_note: Medium's help center says it will issue no new API integration tokens or allow new API integrations, though existing tokens continue to work. Medium still documents RSS feeds for profiles, publications, and topics; paywalled stories are not available as full text. Use only publisher-exposed feeds, respect user-content rights and reasonable API caching, and do not assume the feeds cover all Medium content.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: U; [Google News](https://news.google.com/); chưa xác nhận API công khai được Google hỗ trợ.
items.revalidation_note: The official Google materials reviewed document Google News as a reader and publisher product, not a general public search API for TrendScout. Google News no longer uses RSS feeds or web locations submitted through Publisher Center for publication pages; this does not authorize using an undocumented News RSS/search endpoint. No supported public discovery API or TrendScout permission was established.

revalidation_links.label: Google News crawling and feed infrastructure

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [API alpha](https://developers.google.com/search/apis/trends) giới hạn tester, không mặc định được cấp. Interest không là sales.
items.revalidation_note: The API remains an alpha for a limited set of testers. Google documents a rolling five-year window and daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly intervals; TrendScout access is not approved or verified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [GDELT DOC API](https://blog.gdeltproject.org/gdelt-doc-2-0-api-debuts/); tin trực tuyến toàn cầu, khung thời gian và số kết quả có giới hạn.
items.revalidation_note: GDELT DOC 2.0 provides full-text query search, article lists, and coverage-volume timelines over monitored online news, with a default three-month window (up to one year by timespan) and at most 250 article-list results per query. It measures monitored news coverage, not US population demand; language/geography and publisher coverage are incomplete, and rights to republish source article content remain with publishers.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: F; [RSS 2.0 Specification](https://www.rssboard.org/rss-specification); quyền/độ phủ và điều kiện lưu dùng do từng nhà xuất bản quy định.
items.revalidation_note: RSS is a feed format, not a centralized source or blanket license. A feed only represents the publisher-selected items and fields; commercial collection, retention, display, attribution, and full-text use must be assessed under each publisher's terms. TrendScout must use a specifically identified, permitted feed and must not treat the universe of RSS feeds as complete or representative.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [URL Index](https://www.commoncrawl.org/url-index) và [Terms](https://commoncrawl.org/terms-of-use); dữ liệu theo đợt crawl, quyền nội dung theo từng website.
items.revalidation_note: Common Crawl provides periodically published web-crawl snapshots and URL indexes for analysis; it is not a real-time trend feed, and coverage reflects what its crawler collected. Its terms say crawled content may remain subject to each site owner's terms and third-party rights; commercial reuse needs rights review. Large-scale queries may require paid cloud compute.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: R; [AQS](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Analytics/AQS/Pageviews); pageviews không là unique audience hay intent.
items.revalidation_note: Wikimedia AQS provides aggregate project metrics. This source measures page views, not unique people or demand; the current adapter remains limited to its censored top list.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: R; [SerpApi Google](https://serpapi.com/search-api), shared account với Bing; rank không là volume.
items.revalidation_note: This candidate shares the SerpApi provider with Bing. Pricing and search limits vary by plan; check current terms before any purchase. Account quota, usage rights, and approval are unverified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: R; [SerpApi Bing](https://serpapi.com/bing-search-api); không dùng API Bing Search cũ của Microsoft.
items.revalidation_note: This candidate shares the SerpApi provider with Google. Pricing and search limits vary by plan; check current terms before any purchase. Account quota, usage rights, and approval are unverified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [News API plans](https://newsapi.org/pricing) and [terms](https://newsapi.org/terms); production requires a paid plan, source coverage is not population-representative.
items.revalidation_note: News API supports keyword search across indexed news and blog sources. Its Developer plan is limited to development and testing; staging and production require a paid subscription. Results do not include full article text, plan limits and prices can change, and global publisher coverage does not establish representative US audience demand. TrendScout's plan and data-use rights are unverified.

revalidation_links.label: News API pricing and plan limits

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest); license từng repo, auth/quota và US scope cần review.
items.revalidation_note: Public unauthenticated REST access is limited to 60 requests per hour; authenticated limits are higher and search has separate, stricter limits. Repository activity measures developer activity rather than consumer demand; TrendScout credentials and quota are unverified.

items.category: D. News, technology, open data và search
items.source_reference: G; [OpenAlex API reference](https://help.openalex.org/api/); metadata CC0, measures scholarly publishing rather than general demand.
items.revalidation_note: OpenAlex provides searchable scholarly metadata for works, authors, sources, institutions, and topics; its current API reference states that the data are CC0 and that basic API access is free, with usage limits and higher-volume options. Counts reflect scholarly records and indexing choices, not consumer interest, sales, or broad US demand; article full text retains its own license.

items.source_reference: G; [Open Cloud API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud) and [third-party app policy](https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/37924211313044-Creator-Third-Party-App-Policy); scoped creator access, not a general trend feed.
items.revalidation_note: Roblox Open Cloud exposes creator resources through API keys and OAuth scopes, with access controlled by the creator's permissions; the reviewed materials do not establish a platform-wide public discovery or keyword-trend API for TrendScout. Roblox's third-party app policy limits requested scopes, prohibits selling Roblox API data and user tracking/profiling, and requires expunging data if API access is lost. TrendScout's access and permitted analytics use are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Steam Web API](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/webapi_overview) and [API terms](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apiterms); specific API methods and permitted presentation must be reviewed.
items.revalidation_note: Steam documents public Web API methods as well as protected methods requiring keys or publisher permissions; this does not establish a general search API for all Steam Community discussions or a representative demand measure. Steam Web API terms license an identified application to present Steam Data to end users for personal use, require a confidential key, and state a 100,000-call daily limit. TrendScout's proposed analytics, storage, and commercial presentation rights remain unverified.

revalidation_links.label: Steam Web API Terms of Use

items.source_reference: G; [Goodreads Developers group](https://www.goodreads.com/group/show/8095-goodreads-developers) says no new public API keys have been issued since 2020; current access remains unverified.
items.revalidation_note: Goodreads' official Developers group still states that it stopped issuing new public API developer keys on December 8, 2020 and planned to retire the existing tools. It does not establish a currently supported public discovery API or new access for TrendScout. Do not use legacy keys, scraping, or unofficial endpoints as substitutes; ratings and reviews would also measure Goodreads users, not all readers.

items.source_reference: G; [Letterboxd API access](https://letterboxd.com/api-beta/access/) currently excludes data-analysis and visualization projects.
items.revalidation_note: Letterboxd API access is by request, and its current access page says it is not granting access for data-analysis, visualization, or recommendation projects. Its terms also prohibit exporting content other than a user's own posts and indexing a significant portion of the service without express written authorization. This makes the reviewed API pathway unsuitable for TrendScout trend analytics unless Letterboxd changes its policy or grants specific written permission.

items.source_reference: G; [SoundCloud API guide](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/guide), [rate limits](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/rate-limits), and [terms](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/terms-of-use).
items.revalidation_note: SoundCloud's OAuth 2.1 API supports search for tracks, users, and playlists; results and rate limits are endpoint/app-scoped and limits can change. This is SoundCloud-specific content activity, not overall music demand. API terms require privacy, minimization, and retention controls for personal data, including deletion within seven days after account disconnection; TrendScout access and rights for the intended analytics remain unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Spotify Search API](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/search), [Developer Policy](https://developer.spotify.com/policy), and [quota modes](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/quota-modes).
items.revalidation_note: Spotify's Web API can search catalog metadata, but its Developer Policy expressly prohibits analyzing Spotify Content or the service to create listenership metrics, benchmarks, usage statistics, or user profiles; it also prohibits AI/ML training on Spotify content. Development apps are restricted to five allowlisted users, and wider access requires Spotify review under current eligibility criteria. TrendScout's proposed trend-analysis use is not permitted by the reviewed policy.

items.source_reference: G; [Apple Podcasts Catalog API feed eligibility](https://podcasters.apple.com/support/897-submit-a-show) is opt-in per publisher; Connect analytics are show-owner scoped.
items.revalidation_note: Apple makes a podcast's RSS feed available in the Podcasts Catalog API only when its publisher selects public distribution. Apple Podcasts Connect analytics are for creators managing or claiming their shows, not a platform-wide listening-trend API. Catalog metadata and episode feeds therefore cover only included shows and do not establish audience demand; each publisher's feed terms and content rights still apply.

revalidation_links.label: Apple Podcasts show submission and public Catalog API feeds

items.source_reference: G; [API docs](https://podcastindex-org.github.io/docs-api/) and [Terms](https://github.com/Podcastindex-org/legal/blob/main/TermsOfService.md); podcast metadata is not listening demand.
items.revalidation_note: Podcast Index offers authenticated search across indexed podcast feeds and episodes, but it does not establish listener counts or population demand. Its API terms require following documented request limits and prohibit creating permanent databases or copies of returned third-party content, or caching beyond the response cache header, unless the content owner or law permits it. Feed descriptions and media remain subject to publisher rights; TrendScout use and required attribution are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; [Yelp Places API](https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/places-intro) and [Insights partnership](https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/yelp-insights).
items.revalidation_note: Yelp Places/Fusion API supports local business search by keyword, category, and location, with business attributes and up to three review excerpts. Full review text and deeper business insights require access through Yelp's separate Insights partnership and executed agreement. Yelp listing/review activity is localized to businesses and platform users, not a representative measure of broad US consumer demand; TrendScout's plan and rights are unverified.

items.source_reference: G; current [Tripadvisor Terra](https://docs.terra.tripadvisor.com/docs/overview) uses partner packages and agreement-specific access.
items.revalidation_note: Tripadvisor's current Terra platform provides partner-tier access to location, review, and photo content; each package and agreement controls authorized endpoints, usage rights, quotas, and display requirements. It is travel-content delivery, not a general keyword search or representative measure of US travel demand. The legacy JSON Partner API is in a migration/deprecation process; TrendScout has no verified partnership or content license.

revalidation_links.label: Terra API access and rate limits

items.source_reference: G; [Strava API](https://developers.strava.com/docs/) and [2026 API Policy](https://www.strava.com/legal/api_policy); data is athlete-authorized and cannot be pooled across users in a third-party app.
items.revalidation_note: Strava API access is tied to an athlete's authorization; newly created apps start with capacity for one athlete, and expansion beyond ten requires Strava review. The 2026 API Policy and Agreement restrict sharing a user's data with other app users or third parties and prohibit re-exposing API materials through an aggregator. This blocks TrendScout's intended cross-user trend aggregation; no Strava activity data may be fetched or pooled for that purpose.

revalidation_links.label: Strava API rate limits and athlete capacity

items.source_reference: G; public [Ravelry Goodies](https://www.ravelry.com/about/goodies) points developers to a login-gated API group and user-specific exports.
items.revalidation_note: Ravelry's public developer-facing page points app developers to a login-gated API group and documents project-progress export for a user's own data; its RSS feeds are tailored to individual pages or user activity. The reviewed public materials do not establish an open, platform-wide pattern/project trend API or TrendScout commercial access. Do not infer permission from the presence of community pages or RSS feeds; third-party content rights remain with their owners.

items.source_reference: G; [AllTrails Terms](https://www.alltrails.com/terms) prohibit automated searches/scraping and commercial use without written consent; no public API was verified.
items.revalidation_note: AllTrails' Terms prohibit automated searches, requests, and scraping/mining of the Products, and prohibit commercial use without express written consent. The reviewed official materials do not establish a public developer API for trail, review, or activity discovery. Do not scrape the consumer site or use undocumented endpoints; TrendScout has no verified written permission.
